en.heading: Industrial Cyber profiles ICS/OT practitioner Mike Holcomb
en.summary: Industrial Cyber's Hall of Fame series features Mike Holcomb, described as an ICS/OT cybersecurity leader and community builder. The item is an interview profile and the excerpt reports no incident, vulnerability or regulatory change.
en.takeaway: No action needed; use the quiet day to review your own OT security knowledge sharing and training.
